summary: The Pokémon Pokopia Expansion Pass was revealed and released in June 2026 and features three additional packs released over time adding two new towns and a variety of new features
The purchase will provide players with all three packs as they release.

packs.name: Dynamic Ditto
packs.details: The Pokémon Pokopia Expansion pass released with a special item available. This item is the special Dynamic Ditto pattern for both block and wallpapers

packs.name: Bubbly Basin
packs.details: Bubbly Basin is a new area introduced in the first paid DLC pack for Pokémon Pokopia. This area is underwater and features a variety of underwater Pokémon and the Mythical Pokémon Manaphy

packs.name: Pack 2
packs.details: Pack 2 features a variety of new features. Currently these features are not clear

packs.name: Pack 3
packs.details: Pack 3 features anothuer new town for you all to explore
